title: The Lichen Growing on Bare Rock
short_teaser: Lichens can live on exposed surfaces where few other organisms survive.
story: Lichens can live on exposed surfaces where few other organisms survive. Over time, they help weather rock and contribute to the earliest stages of soil formation. Small beginnings can prepare conditions for life that comes much later. Nature and place can teach timing, interdependence, adaptation, patience, and the value of seeing familiar surroundings with fresh attention. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
